summary: Add the standalone st-decision-fold library crate (decision record grammar, validation and state fold); nothing consumes it yet.

replay.detail: A pure in-memory library: no storage, CLI, daemon or replay integration. No other crate depends on it.

schema.detail: No database schema, claim kind or persisted format; the crate reads and writes no files.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No shipped binary, route, command or protocol links the crate. It is a new workspace member only (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock) and is excluded from the default workspace test run in flake.nix because it has its own hermetic gate.

downtime.detail: No runtime component was added or changed.

manual.detail: No operator action; the README states that an adapter must supply authority, kind and same-tree checks before any consumer relies on it.

recovery.detail: Nothing is persisted; reverting the commit removes an unused crate.
